empirical_response.marker: frozen COI-family aligned FASTA selected before identity opening
empirical_response.edge_genetic_distance: uncorrected p-distance, arithmetic mean across all canonical A/C/G/T cross-locality sequence pairs meeting the frozen comparable-column threshold
empirical_response.ibd_adjustment: endpoint-disjoint cross-fit rank-IBD residualization on each species frozen graph
empirical_response.edge_response: rank01 of the endpoint-disjoint cross-fit IBD residual; the same response definition is used for source and target species

trait_gradient_estimand.pair_alignment: exact response-blind survivor-design target/source edge alignment inherited from v0.2 qualification
trait_gradient_estimand.pair_transfer_congruence: Pearson correlation between aligned source and target post-IBD edge-response values
trait_gradient_estimand.trait_predictor: frozen geometry-residualized four-axis LepTraits similarity from the survivor design
trait_gradient_estimand.per_target_statistic: Pearson correlation across supported source species between residualized trait similarity and pairwise transfer congruence
trait_gradient_estimand.panel_statistic: arithmetic mean over finite supported evaluation-target correlations
trait_gradient_estimand.inference: worst-case one-sided upper-tail Monte Carlo envelope across the independent survivor private and geometry-confounded nuisance reference distributions

secondary_baseline.name: within_lepidoptera_geography_conditioned_transfer
secondary_baseline.role: descriptive second rung only in v0.1 empirical opening
secondary_baseline.definition: mean held-out Spearman transfer score using all geographically supported survivor training Lepidoptera under the unchanged 500-km target-conditioned field

one_shot_decision.interpretation_positive: Within the frozen Lepidoptera survivor domain, ecologically more similar species show greater geographic congruence in post-IBD mitochondrial differentiation beyond measured sampling geometry.
one_shot_decision.interpretation_negative: The frozen study does not detect a positive trait-similarity gradient within the tested Lepidoptera survivor domain; this does not establish zero trait dependence.

integrity_requirements: Exact source archive SHA-256 must match before any nucleotide identity is decoded.
Reconstruct all 240 frozen survivor source panels using FASTA headers and occurrence coordinates only, and require exact geometry equality with the survivor design.

Recompute canonical-valid masks for all 240 frozen survivors and require every frozen survivor edge to remain admissible before identity opening; the exact archive SHA and frozen survivor-design SHA jointly fix the excluded species.
Use only the frozen v0.2 survivor nuisance-reference distributions; no new null selection after the empirical statistic is seen.
Run the empirical statistic exactly once; no threshold, trait, geometry covariate, alignment, response, split or nuisance-family changes after opening.

survivor_references.calibration: maximum of +1 corrected one-sided upper-tail Monte Carlo p-values
